$comment: Capability catalogue: the only operations a VideoSpec may use. Read by the storyboard task (list_capabilities tool), the capability preflight (R-07) and the compiler. From M0 it is generated from media/scenes and backend/demonstrations; this is the agreed draft.

families.name: MathExpression
families.summary: Equation with addressable terms (fractions, operators, powers). Terms link to the objects they stand for.

families.name: NumberSequence
families.summary: Identifiable numbers with stable meaning and colour; optional operator between terms.

families.name: GeometricArrangement
families.summary: Bounded grid, ring, line or group layouts of unit cells, with named groups.

families.name: ObjectTransform
families.summary: Move, rotate, scale, regroup and explicitly map terms.

families.name: FocusHighlight
families.summary: Reveal, hide, highlight, outline, emphasise, dim and undim.

families.name: CaptionAndTakeaway
families.summary: On-screen question, labels and takeaway text (TextBlock), plus the narration caption track.

demonstrationFunctions.name: odd_square_layers
demonstrationFunctions.summary: Layers of an n×n square built from consecutive odd numbers (PRD §10.1). Layer k adds 2k−1 cells: one row of k plus one column of k sharing a corner.

results.layers: array of { k, cellCount (2k−1), cumulative (k²), cells: [{ col, row }] }
